summary: Frontend-only UI/UX review of the FIEZEL premium redesign (vanilla-JS PWA). Executed 9 Playwright runs at 430x900 mobile + one 1440x900 desktop pass covering: language chooser -> ID onboarding (name/Lanjut/Lewati) -> auth gate 'Lanjut tanpa akun' -> Home; bottom-nav routing (5 tabs) and window.go(); Kosakata (incl. vocab quiz answer/feedback/Lanjut gating/Keluar and flashcards); Grammar (hub, lock notes, Dikuasai, lesson detail); Kemajuan (stats, tab visibility, Kemampuan switch); Membaca; Skills hub; Level modal + Settings modal (open + Escape); full Thai locale flow; desktop rail layout; Ruang Guru isolation via ?teacher=preview. Result: every functional requirement in the review request PASSED and zero uncaught JS errors were observed on any view. Found 1 medium interaction defect (grammar lesson title not clickable), 1 English literal leak (flashcard header 'Vocabulary'), unhydrated lucide icon placeholders, a grammar lesson-count data mismatch (30 vs 17), and several minor i18n/design nits. NOTE: the public preview URL intermittently serves a Cloudflare 'Performing security verification' challenge on repeat navigations/reloads, so most runs were done against the same static server on localhost:3000; a final confirmation run on the public URL reproduced identical Home/nav output.

ui_bugs.issue: Lesson row title/label is NOT clickable. Only the small numbered ring button opens the lesson (onclick=openGrammarLesson). Clicking '1. Kata ganti subjek, objek, dan bentuk kepemilikan' does nothing. The ring also runs a perpetual pulse animation - Playwright reports 'element is not stable' for 30s, i.e. it is a continuously moving ~50px tap target for students.
Flashcard screen header shows English literal 'Vocabulary' while ID locale is active (rest of app uses 'Kosakata'). Reached via Kosakata -> 'Belajar dengan kartu'.

Several icons are never hydrated and render as empty boxes: Settings modal rows keep raw <i data-lucide="user">, <i data-lucide="user-x">, <i data-lucide="languages">; Grammar hub keeps <i data-lucide="award"> on the 'Ujian Naik Level' chip and <i data-lucide="list"> on 'Lihat daftar'. Other rows in the same modal DO contain real <svg>, so icon hydration is inconsistent (lucide.createIcons not re-run after dynamic render).
'Keluar' in the vocabulary quiz returns to Home instead of back to the Kosakata page the quiz was launched from.

integration_issues.issue: Home launch card advertises '30 materi · A1' (TH: '30 บทเรียน · A1') but the Grammar page states '17 materi untuk level A1. Kerjakan dari nomor 1, ya.' - two different counts for the same level.

Untranslated / mixed-language strings inside the Thai UI: Membaca page button 'Reading adaptif' (Indonesian word 'adaptif'), progress 'แบบฝึกถัดไป -> Grammar', skill card names Listening/Speaking/Reading/Writing. Thai pronoun register is also inconsistent (Home uses 'คุณ', progress copy uses 'เธอ').

issues: Heading 'Peta kemampuan' is rendered twice back-to-back (section heading + card heading with 'Target kamu · Sekolah' in between)
Prasasti badge copy still uses English jargon in Indonesian text: 'Kuasai 10 lesson sampai ambang mastery' - the word 'mastery'/'lesson' contradicts the 'Mastery -> Dikuasai' student-language goal

Title and subtitle are duplicated: shell header shows 'Bicara & Dengar' + 'Latihan bicara dan mendengar. Suaramu tidak disimpan...' and directly below the hub renders kicker 'LATIHAN SUARA' + h1 'Bicara & Dengar' + a near-identical subtitle

'Ujian Naik Level' chip subtitle 'Sudah jago? Coba naik level' is cream rgba(255,249,238,.72) with an extra opacity:.75 on ink #241A11 => effective ~5.2:1 at 13px. It is readable (not ink-on-ink) but visibly dim; recommend dropping the extra .75 opacity
Content column measures 584px wide, not the intended max 720px

Content block spans x=478..1062 (center 770) while the viewport center is 720, so the column is visually off-centre with a large empty right gutter (rail itself does NOT overlap content: rail x=20 w=84)
Home hero 'PESAN UNTUKMU' body text is clamped with an ellipsis at this width
Label 'ความก้าวหน้า' wraps onto two lines inside the tab pill
'Bahasa Indonesia' label wraps to two lines inside its card while 'ภาษาไทย' fits on one, making the two choice cards visually unbalanced

action_items: Make the whole grammar lesson row (.path-label / .path-step) open the lesson, not just the animated numbered ring; consider pausing the pulse animation once focused/hovered
Translate the flashcard screen header 'Vocabulary' -> 'Kosakata' / Thai equivalent
Re-run lucide icon hydration after every dynamic render (Settings modal rows user/user-x/languages, grammar chip award, 'Lihat daftar' list) so no blank icon boxes remain
Reconcile the grammar lesson count between Home launch card (30) and the Grammar page (17)
Fix Thai copy leaks: 'Reading adaptif' button, 'Grammar' label on progress, and unify the คุณ/เธอ pronoun register
Remove the duplicated 'Peta kemampuan' heading on Kemajuan and the duplicated title/subtitle block on the Skills hub
Replace remaining English jargon in ID copy: 'ambang mastery' / 'lesson' in the Prasasti badge descriptions
Desktop: widen the centred column to the intended 720px and centre it against the viewport (currently 584px, centre offset +50px)

Add data-testid attributes to the student flow (language choice, onboarding next/skip, #authGateSkip, nav tabs, .path-node lesson buttons, quiz .option, level/settings modal roots) - only the teacher panel currently exposes tg-* testids
Make 'Keluar' in the vocab quiz return to the Kosakata page instead of Home
critical_code_review_comments: features/ui/fiezel-student-mode.js hides panels by matching normalised heading TEXT against i18n keys. This is brittle: any copy edit or a new locale silently un-hides 'Laporan Diagnostik'/'Analisis'/'Cara soal dipilih'. Prefer a stable data-attribute/id on the panels instead of text matching.

The same file toggles body.fz-lux from a MutationObserver on body[class]; combined with wrapping global enhanceUI/render this is invisible coupling to app.js internals. It worked in all tested transitions (student <-> teacher) but should be driven by an explicit mode API.

Dynamic HTML strings emit <i data-lucide="..."> placeholders that depend on a later createIcons() pass; several code paths never run it, producing empty icon boxes. Centralise icon rendering (or inline the SVG) at markup-build time.
Grammar lesson affordance: clickable behaviour lives only on the decorative .path-node ring while the semantic label is inert - an accessibility/hit-area problem for the primary learning action.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the 14 requested scenarios verified; ~93% fully clean (grammar lesson-title click + flashcard 'Vocabulary' literal are the two spec deviations)

seed_data_creation: None. Guest mode only (name 'Rara' for ID, 'Nok' for TH); teacher preview used the built-in demo class (18 students) via data-testid='tg-welcome-demo'. All state is localStorage-local.
test_credentials: None needed - static PWA, guest via 'Lanjut tanpa akun' (#authGateSkip); teacher preview via ?teacher=preview then window.go('tutor')
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview URL intermittently returns a Cloudflare 'Performing security verification' interstitial on page.reload()/second goto - when that happens the app boots into the 'Materi belum bisa dimuat' error card with English fallback nav labels (NOT an app bug). Test against http://localhost:3000 (same tools/preview-server.mjs static server) or use only the harness's single initial navigation. Onboarding has no data-testid; working selectors: [data-ob-locale="id"] / [data-ob-locale="th"], .fiezel-ob input (placeholder 'Tulis nama kamu' / 'พิมพ์ชื่อของคุณ'), .fiezel-ob button:has-text('Lanjut'|'ต่อไป'), .fiezel-ob button:has-text('Lewati'|'ข้าม'), #authGateSkip, then remove '.fiezel-splash,.fiezel-ob,.fz-tour'. Splash needs ~7s before the chooser is interactive. Grammar lesson opens ONLY via #app .path-node (needs click(force=True) - perpetual animation). Progress hidden tabs are marked data-fz-student-hide. #fiezelDiagHost contains the text 'Diagnostics' but is 0x0 and off-viewport, so text-only scans give a false positive - it is NOT visible to users. Verified clean: fz-lux applied, all forbidden literals absent (Vocabulary Hub / Today Plan / Grammar Hub / FIEZEL CONTROL ROOM / Classroom / Coming Soon / Laporan Diagnostik), teacher mode has no fz-lux and reverts correctly.
